name: Cold Fortitude
text:
**Cold Fortitude** (race trait; Kobold)

The perpetually chilly environment of your youth made you exceptionally resilient in arctic climes. You gain a +4 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws against nonlethal cold damage.
